⭐ Notable Mentions — Worth Trying When Ready

Egg & Veggie Fried Rice

Use leftover rice from the previous day. Scramble eggs in, add chopped carrots, peas, capsicum, and soy sauce. Cook needs to use high flame and not over-stir — that’s the only real trick here.

⚠ Medium · needs high flame technique

Ragi / Bajra Roti + Dal

Swap wheat roti with bajra or ragi 2–3 days a week. Much higher fiber and minerals. These doughs are stickier and harder to roll thin — worth a few dedicated practice sessions with the cook.

⚠ Hard · dough handling is tricky

Chicken Keema + Roti

Minced chicken with peas and spices. More flavorful than curry and higher protein density. Cook needs to ensure keema is fully cooked through. Great Saturday dinner upgrade.

⚠ Medium · doneness check needed

Chana + Boiled Egg Salad (Side)

Boiled white chana + sliced boiled eggs + onion + tomato + lemon + chaat masala. No active cooking once chana is boiled. A great add-on to any lunch to bump up protein without extra effort.

✅ Easy · no cooking needed
